name: ReleaseReview
goal: Take a change from an articulated plan to a reviewed, verified release candidate without any stage grading its own work.

stages.title: Write done down
stages.input: the change request, as an issue or a prompt
stages.output: an ISA whose claims are falsifiable
done_criteria: Every claim in the ISA names the probe that closes it.
At least one anti-claim states what must not become true.

stages.title: Take the frontier claims
stages.input: the ISA from the plan stage
stages.output: a working tree that takes the claims on the frontier
done_criteria: Every claim taken this pass has a code change behind it.
The test suite ran and its output is captured verbatim.

stages.title: Second look from another family
stages.output: a findings list ranked by severity
done_criteria: Every finding names the file and the line it applies to.
The reviewing role is a different vendor family from the builder.

stages.title: Close the claims on evidence
stages.input: the ISA and the reviewed tree
stages.output: an evidence trail, one entry per closed claim
done_criteria: Each claim marked done quotes the command and its output.
No claim is closed on an assertion that it would pass.

anti_claims: No stage reports done for a criterion whose probe was never run.
The builder never reviews its own diff.
No claim is closed from memory of an earlier run.
